verdict.rationale: Docs show agents can run in the background while the user keeps working, spinning up multiple subagents in parallel and tracking them via inline cards (docs-12, docs-13, docs-30), and built-in 'programs' like goal/deep-research act as autonomous workflows (docs-14). However, there's no evidence of scheduling, triggers, or unattended automation that runs without an active session/user present—everything described is user-initiated within a live session. Missing for 10: scheduled/triggered automation setup, persistent execution outside an active session, and independent confirmation that background agents complete tasks reliably.
